title: Comparison between a xenogeneic dermal matrix and connective tissue graft for the treatment of multiple adjacent gingival recessions: a randomized controlled clinical trial
authors: Meza-Mauricio J, Cortez-Gianezzi J, Duarte PM, Tavelli L, Rasperini G, de Faveri M. Clin. Oral Investig. 2021 May;25(12), 6919-6929. doi: 10.1007/s00784-021-03982-w.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The two treatments showed similar mRC. However, CAF+CTG was superior to CAF+XDM in providing CRC and in gaining GT. CAF+XDM demonstrated advantages over CAF+CTG with regard to patient morbidity and surgical time” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
